Subject: Commit sparring: Safety-net save-plan and stage clarity for NeuroSync

Team / Elena —

Quick hygiene push for DEAL-4729 (NeuroSync). We are at a fragile stage (legal + procurement gating the PO). I pulled a quick red/yellow/green snapshot in the attached spreadsheet and PDF. Action items below — please treat as high priority for today so finance can bake Q3 coverage: 

- Owners: confirm the current opportunity "stage" in HubSpot and update the estimated close date (column B/C in the sheet) by EOD local.
- Red: deals where procurement/legal signoff is pending and no PO commitment — need a save plan and fallback model.
- Yellow: verbal commit or legal drafting; require written confirmation by next Tue (2027-07-06).
- Green: PO or signed SOW received — mark closed-won forecastable.

Specific asks:
1) Aditya — add the latest procurement contact notes in the sheet (row 8) and call out the gating clause.
2) Vivek — recommend a safety-net pricing concession or accelerated implementation credit (if we must close by 7/12).
3) Priyom — prepare a one-pager contingency path (what we do if PO slips to July end).
4) Elena — if procurement can share a PO timeline or confirm required SOW edits, upload to the Drive link or reply to this thread.

Attachments: pipeline_saveplan_q3.xlsx (tabbed by risk), commit_risk_dashboard.pdf

Thanks — I want a short 15-min sync at 4 PM PT to confirm final labels and next steps. If you cannot make it, update the sheet and leave a 1-line note in thread.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Appreciate the heads-up. My recommended safety-net (short note):
- Offer an early-implementation credit worth one month of service if NeuroSync signs PO by 2027-07-12 and accepts a 45-day payment term. This preserves full list pricing but accelerates onboarding and reduces perceived cost.
- If legal requires additional DP language beyond our standard, propose a limited-scope audit log commitment (30 days) rather than an open retention promise.

I've updated the spreadsheet with the two proposed concessions (column G/H) and moved NeuroSync from "red" to "yellow" pending Elena's confirmation on 45-day term.

I'll join the 4 PM PT sync and bring a short script for the executive ask.

— Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts (on behalf of Product Pricing), Redwood Inference
